in_marathi.name: Astha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Astha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Astha is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'asti', which means 'to exist'. The name signifies truth, reality, and the eternal existence of the divine. In Hindu mythology, Astha is also known as the eight primary elements that make up the universe: Prithvi (earth), Apas (water), Tejas (fire), Vayu (air), Akasha (ether), Anila (wind), and Surya (sun).
